_readme: Music artists of the stream, keyed exactly as the music indexes name them (wavlake-index.json, plebrap-index.json): the Nostr identity found over their kind-0 profiles and the QR target the now-playing card shows (MusicCredits: lud16 first, then the njump profile, YouTube, the Wavlake page). Researched 2026-10-15; evidence and confidence per artist. A lightning address matched by name only (confidence medium) is not used: the card points at the artist's Wavlake track instead, so no sats reach a namesake. After a change run php artisan twentyone:music-qr and commit the codes.

DJ Bitcoin.evidence: House artist of the uncredited instrumentals and own songs, set by the user 2026-10-15. Picture from the kind-0 of the key getalby.com/.well-known/nostr.json names for theben (purplepag.es, 2026-10-15).

Bilingual Original Music') matches his YouTube channel description and its website is youtube.com/@arthuryoria. Two older profiles (npub1nuvh7948..., npub1fccp7zj4...) carry arthuryoria@getalby.com as an alternative address. kind 0 seen on 1 of 7 general relays (purplepag.es).
